rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This LDAP server exposes directory operations through MCP, enabling clients to perform directory searches, entry retrieval, and CRUD operations. Built with Go and featuring automatic reconnection logic, StartTLS/LDAPS support, and configurable read-only mode for safety, it provides five core tools (search_entries, get_entry, add_entry, modify_entry, delete_entry) along with resources for accessing the directory root DSE and arbitrary entries by DN. The implementation includes robust input validation, paged search results, and graceful error handling, making it useful for directory management, user provisioning workflows, and automated LDAP administration tasks.
